description: Generate test cases from a function signature. Produces happy path, edge cases, error cases, and boundary value tests as Jest/Vitest test code.

framework.description: Test framework to generate for (default: vitest)

module_path.description: Import path for the module under test (default: "./module")

signature.description: The function signature to generate tests for, e.g. "export async function fetchUser(id: number): Promise<User>"

name: generate_tests
